claude_code.scope: user (REQUIRED; default 'local' is git-root-scoped and breaks cross-project use)
claude_code.stdio_framing: newline-delimited JSON (NOT Content-Length); host must use non-blocking read

chatgpt_desktop.bundle_id: com.openai.chat (26.x also answers to com.openai.codex — match both)
chatgpt_desktop.ax_requires_optin: AXManualAccessibility + AXEnhancedUserInterface on the app element
chatgpt_desktop.ax_editable_attr: NOT exposed since 26.x (kAXErrorNoValue) — two-pass candidate logic: pass 1 explicit true, pass 2 not-explicit-false
chatgpt_desktop.inject_method: kAXValueAttribute set-value (preferred; still effective on 26.x); Cmd+V paste (fallback, needs focus wait)

kimi_work.ax_requires_optin: AXManualAccessibility on the app element (accepted, unlike ChatGPT 26.x which needs the pair)
kimi_work.ax_window_resolution: AXWindows stays EMPTY with a visible window; app-element subtree exposes only menu bars — use AXFocusedWindow/AXMainWindow and BFS from the window (AXComposerFinder.resolveWindow)
kimi_work.ax_input_role: AXTextArea (exactly one; desc=placeholder '随时发消息，安排下一步'; AXEditable not exposed)
kimi_work.inject_method: focus composer + clipboard paste via CGEvent Cmd+V (kAXValueAttribute set-value returns success but does NOT take effect — placeholder pollution)
kimi_work.new_chat_button: sidebar button desc='新建会话' (title empty on this build); AXPress before paste, degrade to current composer if absent

floating_window.notes: close button must hide not destroy (isReleasedWhenClosed=false)

ax_apps._strategy: native kAXSelectedText | chromium AXManualAccessibility opt-in | safari AXSelectedTextMarkerRange | electron-editor clipboard fallback

com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap.note: tested on sign-in page; re-test signed in

com.apple.mail.note: list select gives AXTable; message-body selection is native text

com.microsoft.VSCode.note: Electron/Monaco not via kAXSelectedText -> clipboard fallback
